title: Implement declared/runtime facts and hardware acceptance
goal: Implement the canonical NixOS executor facts boundary: generated declared facts bound to the exact approved system closure, separately observed source-bound runtime facts, and hardware-acceptance evidence that can reuse archived physical Gate A/B evidence as historical evidence without presenting it as current live truth.

approval.note: Repository changes are confined to the declared facts/acceptance scope. Host access is read-only for fresh hardware/runtime observation; this task grants no activation, storage, EFI, firmware or reboot authority.

acceptance.assertion: Declared facts are generated from the exact approved NixOS system closure/control release and are not maintained as an independent current-truth file in Git.

Runtime facts remain separate from desired state and carry source, observation time, freshness and immutable evidence binding; runtime observation cannot silently rewrite declared configuration truth.

The archived physical Gate A/B evidence at archive 20260902T112439Z-5eabac896f53 / head 7fd5eed229fae95e839e6b9556cd7f4782506d2a is consumed or referenced as historical evidence and cannot be mistaken for a fresh runtime observation.

Acceptance surfaces cover the canonical 2026 anchors including RTX 4070 Ti SUPER graphics/GPU, MOTU M2 audio and Roland FP-30X MIDI while requiring fresh source-bound readback on the exact reviewed revision before any later cutover decision.
No acceptance step in this task partitions or formats production storage, mutates LUKS/EFI/Secure-Boot/firmware state, activates a new production NixOS closure, or reboots the production host.
Focused contract tests plus required repository CI are green on the exact reviewed head before merge.
